verdict: Ads have been paused for 21 days; pipeline clarity is being restored.
narrative: Paid ads stopped running on September 15, meaning all 6 leads recorded this period came in before September 12 — the last two-thirds of the window ran on zero spend. Google Business Profile activity fell 18% week-over-week and Instagram reach dropped sharply over the same stretch, both consistent with no paid amplification behind them. Separately, there is a gap between the 6 leads reported by Meta and the 174 contacts and 12 opportunities showing in your CRM; that reconciliation has been overdue and is being closed now so your true pipeline is visible. Website sessions are up 13% week-over-week on organic traffic alone, which is a quiet positive, though conversion tracking needs a repair before those sessions can be counted as leads. Ads are being reactivated and attribution is being resolved this period, so next week's numbers should reflect a full picture again.

watch_item.issue: Paid ads have been dark for 21 consecutive days, and the true lead count between Meta and your CRM remains unreconciled.
watch_item.fix: Ads are being reactivated this week and the attribution gap is being closed so both the pipeline count and spend reporting are accurate going forward.
